motions.motion: APPROVE a Site Plan Amendment to the “Highland Park” Planned Unit Development, a residential 11-unit development within the R-M Zone located at 4880 South Highland Circle, subject to the following: City of Holladay Planning Commission Meeting - 06/24/2025 4 Findings: 1. Complies with the allowed land uses in the R-M Zone. 2. No changes are being made to any of the previous approvals for the PUD. 3. Replacement Tree Canopy coverage provides for the future preservation and enhancement of desirable site characteristics. Conditions: 1. Tree removals are only as designated. 2. Replacement trees to be planted as shown. Significant deviations must be approved by the Planning Commission. 3. The developer was strongly urged you to try to keep Trees #2, 4, and 5 on the back end of the property

motions.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Commission.
